title: AI agents
switch: Let AI agents see your library
switchHint: Agent apps that speak MCP, such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop or Cursor, can search your library and look at your assets while Mimikit is open. Each app asks you first, and changes nothing unless you let it.
offNote: Turning this off forgets the apps you allowed.
claudeCode: Claude Code: run this once in a terminal.
mcpJson: Claude Desktop, Cursor and other apps with an mcpServers file: add this to it, then restart the app. Claude Desktop's is under Settings › Developer › Edit Config.
other: Any other MCP app, such as VS Code: add a stdio server that runs this program with the argument mcp.
copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it instead.
none: None yet. Once an agent app is set up, ask it something like “find a coin sprite in Mimikit”.
paused: Paused: it can still search and look, but its changes are refused until you resume.
allowedHint: Their new sessions connect without asking.
askBody: It can search your library, read its file names, folders, tags and notes, and look at your assets. It can't change anything unless you also let it, in Settings › AI agents, where you can disconnect it at any time.
allowChangesHint: It can then tag and rate assets, mark favorites, write notes, make collections and copy files into folders. It can't move, rename or delete files. Each change shows under What agents did, with Undo.
activityHint: The last 50 changes since Mimikit started, with the values they replaced.
